notes: LIKELY MISIDENTIFIED PARENT (research 2026-07-03, plausible, not certain): no period New Jersey record of an 'Elijah Tomlinson' turned up in any search of NJ colonial will calendars, Gloucester Co. genealogy compilations, or the Tomlinson Family Papers finding aid (Huntington Library) — the only 'Elijah Tomlinson' found anywhere is a 19th-century Elijah S. Tomlinson (b. 1850), a different era/person. By contrast, an independently documented John Tomlinson of Gloucester Township — matching this tree's John Tomlinson (I182197756552) on marriage partner surname (Fairlamb), era, and township — is on record as son of Joseph Tomlinson (will dated 20 Aug 1719, proved 20 May 1720, naming wife Elizabeth and ten children) and his wife Elizabeth (surname given elsewhere as Shevier/Shivers). Recommend treating 'Elijah/Grace' as unsupported lore pending a primary source (the tree's own cited 'New Jersey, Abstract of Wills, 1670-1817' entry for John Tomlinson, not independently pulled in this research pass) and treating 'Joseph/Elizabeth' as the better-evidenced working hypothesis. Source: Genealogy Trails Gloucester Co. NJ Will Calendar; OAC finding aid, Tomlinson Family Papers 1683-1899.
